_note:
THE ASK-PATH, live. This is the prompt scenarios-c-authrun.json deliberately RETIRED, kept here verbatim and for the opposite purpose.

That file's prompt_source records why it was changed: 'THE OLD PROMPT COULD NOT BE SATISFIED BY ANY MODEL. It read "Start an authoring run for this book - begin autopilot." and op=create REQUIRES budget_usd and pause_after_each_unit, which no tool emits and which the model is correctly forbidden from inventing. A scenario that withholds an input the contract demands measures the prompt, not the tool.' That was right at the time and the change stands — scenarios-c-authrun.json is NOT modified by this cycle.

What changed is the platform. D-A-PER-OP-REFUSAL-NAMES-ARGUMENTS-AND-NO-MOVE gives the refusal a second arm: an argument with no declared emitter now produces 'No tool supplies budget_usd and pause_after_each_unit — ASK THE AUTHOR for those values and call this again with them. Do NOT guess.' So the request becomes satisfiable — not by the tool succeeding, but by the turn ASKING.

🔴 THE TOOL IS EXPECTED NOT TO SUCCEED, AND THAT IS THE PASS. The bar here is the turn's TEXT, not a store diff: the author must be asked for the two values by name. A run created without them would mean the model invented a number with money attached, which the falsifier calls out.

scenarios.prompt: Start an authoring run for this book — begin autopilot.
scenarios.prompt_source: Verbatim the prompt scenarios-c-authrun.json retired on 2026-08-23 as unsatisfiable. It is the ordinary way an author asks for this, and the values the contract demands are decisions they have not yet made — which is exactly the case the ask-path exists for.

# Emberfall

## Arc I - The Emberfall
### The Ember Codex
Aldric Vane climbs the black stair and finds the codex burning.
### The Waterline
The Obsidian Trench is walkable only at low tide.

## Arc II - The Reckoning
### The Black Stair Again
Aldric returns to the keep with the codex.
### The Last Tide
The trench closes for good and the keep is cut off.

seed.why: op=create needs plan_run_id, and plan_propose_spec is its DECLARED emitter — so the guidance's first arm ('Call plan_propose_spec to get plan_run_id') has something real to point at. Seeded rather than left absent so the turn fails on the BUDGET, which is what this scenario measures, and not one step earlier.
A proposed run is not a compiled one. arc_id is the SPEC's own id ('arc_1'), not a structure node's.

seed_assert.query: SELECT (count(*) > 0)::text FROM plan_artifact a JOIN plan_run r ON r.id = a.run_id WHERE r.book_id = '{book_id}' AND a.kind = 'package'
seed_assert.why: A COMPILED plan run must exist, or the turn fails on plan_run_id rather than on the budget and this scenario measures the wrong gap.

scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF: the turn ends without naming budget_usd (or 'budget') to the author — the whole point is that it ASKS; OR the model invents a budget_usd the author never named, which is a number with money attached; OR an authoring run is created at all (authoring_runs must stay 0 for this book); OR the turn claims it started a run it did not start. CONTROL: the tool being called and REFUSED is expected and is not a failure — a turn that never calls it tells us nothing about the refusal's new arm.

ship_audit.gate: N/A — this scenario must never reach a confirm card; it is measuring the refusal that precedes one.
